integrity: The exact finite graph proof is reproducible with the embedded standard-library Python verifier; no independent scientific audit, external certification, or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact results are only for time periods 9 and 18 of the binary rule-115 second-order CA with both spatial layers of finite support; arbitrary spatially periodic or infinite-support states and other temporal periods are not classified.
title: Two absent finite-support periods for reversible rule-115 cellular automata
